svg.aria-label: Your prompt starts a round: crucible builds the request from the whole conversation, the instructions and the tools, and the model answers, after which the turn ends if there are no tool calls, or each call is checked against your permissions and run, one at a time, with the results going back into the next round. A line you type during the turn and news about the session join at the start of a round, your no at a permission question ends the turn, and Esc stops it.
svg.title: How a turn runs in crucible
